WITH s AS (SELECT iri FROM substance WHERE unii='X0Z7454B90'),
ps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pi.owner_iri AS product_iri FROM product__ingredients pi
  WHERE pi.substance_iri IN (SELECT iri FROM s)
     OR pi.substance_iri IN (SELECT owner_iri FROM substance__active_moiety WHERE moiety_iri IN (SELECT iri FROM s))
)
SELECT DISTINCT o.iri, o.name, p.product_ndc, p.name AS product_name
FROM recall r
JOIN recall__products rp ON rp.owner_iri = r.iri
JOIN ps ON ps.product_iri = rp.target_iri
JOIN product p ON p.iri = rp.target_iri
JOIN organization o ON o.iri = r.recalling_firm_iri

WITH para_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.iri, p.clinical_drug_iri
  FROM product p
  JOIN product__ingredients i ON i.owner_iri = p.iri
  JOIN substance s ON s.iri = i.substance_iri
  LEFT JOIN substance__active_moiety am ON am.owner_iri = s.iri
  LEFT JOIN substance m ON m.iri = am.moiety_iri
  WHERE s.unii = 'X2ELS050D8' OR m.unii = 'X2ELS050D8'
),
product_cds AS (
  SELECT pp.iri AS product_iri, pp.clinical_drug_iri AS cd FROM para_products pp WHERE pp.clinical_drug_iri IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT pp.iri, dm.clinical_drug_iri FROM para_products pp JOIN product__drug_mappings dm ON dm.owner_iri = pp.iri
),
report_cds AS (
  SELECT d.owner_iri AS report_iri, d.clinical_drug_iri AS cd FROM adverse_event_report__drugs d WHERE d.clinical_drug_iri IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT d.owner_iri, h.target_iri FROM adverse_event_report__drugs d JOIN adverse_event_report__drugs__harmonized_clinical_drugs h ON h.owner_iri = d.iri
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.iri) AS n
FROM adverse_event_report r
WHERE r.serious = true
  AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
  AND r.iri IN (
    SELECT rc.report_iri FROM report_cds rc JOIN product_cds pc ON pc.cd = rc.cd
  );

SELECT s.iri, s.unii, s.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM product__ingredients i WHERE i.substance_iri=s.iri) AS n_products
FROM substance s WHERE s.unii='X2ELS050D8' OR s.name ILIKE '%paroxetine%';

FROM product p JOIN product__ingredients i ON i.owner_iri=p.iri JOIN substance s ON s.iri=i.substance_iri
LEFT JOIN substance__active_moiety am ON am.owner_iri=s.iri LEFT JOIN substance m ON m.iri=am.moiety_iri
WHERE s.unii IN ('X2ELS050D8','3I3T11UD2S','41VRH5220H') OR m.unii IN ('X2ELS050D8','41VRH5220H')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4;

MATCH (s:Substance {unii:'68JRS2HC1C'})<-[:INGREDIENT]-(p:Product)

WITH para_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.iri, p.clinical_drug_iri
  FROM product p
  JOIN product__ingredients i ON i.owner_iri = p.iri
  JOIN substance s ON s.iri = i.substance_iri
  LEFT JOIN substance__active_moiety am ON am.owner_iri = s.iri
  LEFT JOIN substance m ON m.iri = am.moiety_iri
  WHERE s.unii = 'X2ELS050D8' OR m.unii = 'X2ELS050D8'
),
product_cds AS (
  SELECT pp.iri AS product_iri, pp.clinical_drug_iri AS cd FROM para_products pp WHERE pp.clinical_drug_iri IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT pp.iri, dm.clinical_drug_iri FROM para_products pp JOIN product__drug_mappings dm ON dm.owner_iri = pp.iri
),
report_cds AS (
  SELECT d.owner_iri AS report_iri, d.clinical_drug_iri AS cd FROM adverse_event_report__drugs d WHERE d.clinical_drug_iri IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT d.owner_iri, h.target_iri FROM adverse_event_report__drugs d JOIN adverse_event_report__drugs__harmonized_clinical_drugs h ON h.owner_iri = d.iri
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.iri) AS n
FROM adverse_event_report r
WHERE r.serious = true
  AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
  AND r.iri IN (
    SELECT rc.report_iri FROM report_cds rc JOIN product_cds pc ON pc.cd = rc.cd
  );

SELECT s.iri, s.unii, s.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM product__ingredients i WHERE i.substance_iri=s.iri) AS n_products
FROM substance s WHERE s.unii='X2ELS050D8' OR s.name ILIKE '%paroxetine%';

SELECT s.unii, s.name, m.unii AS moiety_unii, m.name AS moiety_name, count(DISTINCT p.iri) AS products

LEFT JOIN substance__active_moiety am ON am.owner_iri=s.iri LEFT JOIN substance m ON m.iri=am.moiety_iri
WHERE s.unii IN ('X2ELS050D8','3I3T11UD2S','41VRH5220H') OR m.unii IN ('X2ELS050D8','41VRH5220H')

FROM recall r
JOIN recall__products rp ON rp.owner_iri = r.iri
JOIN product p ON p.iri = rp.target_iri

  JOIN organization l ON l.iri = pp.labeler_iri
  WHERE l.iri IN (SELECT iri FROM organization WHERE name ILIKE '%thea pharma%' OR slug ILIKE '%thea-pharma%'
     UNION SELECT owner_iri FROM organization__aliases WHERE name ILIKE '%thea pharma%')
)
JOIN organization o ON o.iri = r.recalling_firm_iri
ORDER BY r.recall_number;
